concerns.text: T104 requires the convergence monitor to flag iterations with 'tolerance < 1e-4', but the convergence-log record schema defined in T101 ([iteration_id, sample_size, converged, max_iterations, error_message]) has no 'tolerance' field. The specified check can never fire, so the SC-004 convergence-diagnostics acceptance criterion is silently unverifiable. Either add 'tolerance' to the T101 log schema or drop the tolerance check from T104.

Spec US-3/FR-002 define the sensitivity variable as spatial smoothing kernels of 4mm vs 8mm (fMRIPrep); the tasks implement temporal kernels '4 s / 8 s' (V03, T105 'both temporal kernels (4 s, 8 s)'). SC-003's 'impact of preprocessing choices' is thus measured on a different variable than the spec defines, with no documented amendment — a silent constraint substitution, not a staged simplification acknowledged in the spec.

T103 asserts 'data/derived/processed_roi/roi_timeseries.csv' exists, but the data model specifies '{dataset_id}_{kernel}.csv' in that directory. The expected artifact path is ambiguous to the implementer and to the T103 verification step; pick one path and align the data model or the task.

FR-005 specifies fixed effects 'sample size, preprocessing variant, and estimated noise level'; the plan (and T105's reliance on V06) adds 'effect_size_group' as a fourth predictor and renames noise to 'SNR level'. The tasks never state which predictor set the logistic model in T105 must use, leaving the FR-005 constraint ambiguous at execution time. State the predictor set explicitly in T105 (and note any addition relative to FR-005).
